fact: The Standards Association of Zimbabwe's accreditations page lists ZWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (information security management systems) as a Zimbabwe standard (ZWS) with a certification scheme; the page does not state the body's legal basis, and its own date is 2023-03-06 with content updated to February 2026, so February 2026 is the stated event date.

SAZ Certification Services, the certifier, states its ZWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (ISMS) certification scheme was accredited to ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015 by the Southern African Development Community Accreditation Services (SADCAS) in February 2026; the page names no certified organisation.

The Ministry of Industry and Commerce's National Quality Policy 2021-2025 states that a standards body exists, the Standards Association of Zimbabwe (SAZ), which develops national standards, but that it is not rooted in enabling legislation (no legislation on standardisation) and that Government will legislate and rebrand it as the Standards Institute Zimbabwe; the document gives its own published date (2021) and names no IT or data standard.
